reason: The first refinement already removes the centroid/height/volume discrepancy; controls are placed at n=6 and n=12 to test the transition. n=18/24 remain on the main spatial ladder.
depth_sampling: Equal-volume rectangular strata: nx=4n, ny=floor(L), nz=(8n/3)*L/ny; selected fractions have integral nz, constant m, and geometric volume=N*dx^3. Avoids only testing depths commensurate with one particle layer.
time_controls: Half dt at n=6,12,18, unchanged model; sixteen iterations at n=12.
cost: First ladder timings are exploratory and include an overlapping equivalence/build probe. A separate serial timing series provides admitted cost; no audits/builds or transfers during it.
unchanged: All accuracy thresholds, physical collision geometry and total mass remain fixed.
